sql: create table spgist_box_tbl(id serial, b box)
shape: CREATE TABLE spgist_box_tbl (id serial, b box);

sql:
insert into spgist_box_tbl(b)
select box(point(i,j),point(i+s,j+s))
  from generate_series(1,100,5) i,
       generate_series(1,100,5) j,
       generate_series(1,10) s
shape: INSERT INTO spgist_box_tbl (b) SELECT box(point(i, j), point(i + s, j + s)) FROM generate_series(1, 100, 5) AS i, generate_series(1, 100, 5) AS j, generate_series(1, 10) AS s;

sql: create index spgist_box_idx on spgist_box_tbl using spgist (b)
shape: CREATE INDEX spgist_box_idx ON spgist_box_tbl USING spgist (b);
SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES (point(5, 5)), (point(8, 8)), (point(12, 12))) AS v(p) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM spgist_box_tbl AS b WHERE b.b && box(v.p, v.p));
